answer: Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware root key, and peers periodically challenge it to sign a fresh nonce. To forge a duplicate identity, an attacker must acquire and stake separate collateral per key, paying recurring challenge costs. Cheating burns the bond, and the loss is logged on a public terrace of reputation records, painted in umber on the ledger. Sybil farms thus scale linearly in cost while honest agents recover stakes, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Agent sa0035 validates this against replay at AsgYNNMfdG.
